interview.question: Decide all eight GUIDs independently using attributable redacted evidence, explicit selected scope/content/time/expiry binding and separate exceptions. C01.01: cite the approved organization-specific naming standard, covered resource types/scopes, component order and immutable versus mutable metadata, actual adoption, ownership and exceptions; Azure syntax/examples/counts are not approval and no resource names or private tag values are retained. C02.01: declare the authoritative tenant root and ALZ intermediate root, exact level-counting convention, complete dated hierarchy and justified flatness/exceptions; immutable four-level wording must be reconciled with current CAF ideally three-to-four guidance, separately from the six-level service limit excluding tenant root/subscriptions. Supplied relative MG edges exclude the selected anchor and subscriptions and do not determine estate depth. C02.02: explicitly designate the sandbox and evidence experimentation, isolation from development/test/production, guardrails, access, cost/lifecycle and actual operating ownership; a label or group is insufficient. C02.03: designate the platform and intended tenant/intermediate parent, substantiate direct placement and common platform Policy/RBAC and accountable ownership; do not infer purpose/root from names or parentage. C02.04: designate the dedicated connectivity subscription and intended Connectivity MG, substantiate actual membership, required central networking/DNS/ER or justified alternatives and scale/regional exceptions; subscription or networking presence does not prove dedicated use. C02.05: separately establish authoritative tenant root, complete existing subscription placement and approved exceptions, and the explicit default group for future subscriptions; defaultManagementGroup does not relocate existing subscriptions or prove absence at root. C02.06: reconcile the explicit requireAuthorizationForGroupCreation setting attached to independently designated tenant root with separately evidenced effective least-privileged create/move/delete/settings/access operations, inheritance, PIM and emergency exceptions; the creation toggle and settings-read/write role do not prove all privileged operations. C02.07: bind each designated landing-zones child group to approved security/compliance/connectivity/feature requirements, actual placement and effective Policy/ownership; do not copy organizational charts or infer business purpose from graph shape. Missing/partial/ambiguous/stale/denied/unsupported/over-bound inputs remain unknown. No tenant reads, changes, queries or fabricated owner confirmation. Signals and humanConfirmed never manufacture Verified.

Reviewer decision: cite approved resource-type/scope coverage, component order, immutable naming versus mutable metadata, accountable ownership and actual adoption using redacted dated references.

Reviewer decision: independently reconcile Azure resource constraints, sensitive-data exclusion, migration/legacy exceptions and ongoing maintenance. Do not prescribe a universal delimiter, regex or example naming convention.
recommendations.limitations: Assisted document workflow, no machine naming compliance predicate. Public examples and name syntax cannot prove an approved naming standard or estate-wide adoption.
